action.content: We aim to study how words shift over long spans of time. Many groups speak in ways that differ from old days. This project will look at how talk changes when people move or meet new friends. We want to know why some sounds fade while others stay strong. Our team will gather data from many lands where folks still use ancient ways to speak. We will listen to elders and write down their stories. This work needs great care and much time. We hope to find patterns that show how human thought shapes sound. No one knows all the rules that guide this slow drift. Some words vanish while new ones appear to fill the gap. We will track these shifts with great focus. Our goal is to map the path of language from past to now. We need funds to travel to far places and record voices. This effort will help us understand how we all connect through speech. We believe this study will bring fresh light to old questions. Many scholars have tried before but missed key points. We will use new tools to see what was hidden before. Our plan is simple yet bold. We will ask people to share their tales and songs. We will note how they say things today versus how they spoke long ago. This data will help us build a clear picture of change. We want to show that language is never still. It moves like water or wind. We hope to publish our findings in major journals soon. This work matters for all who love words. It helps us see our shared history. We ask for support to make this dream come true. Let us join hands to save these fading voices. The future of our words depends on what we do now. We must act fast before more is lost. This project offers a chance to learn how we all think and feel. We are ready to start this journey right away. Please help us make this happen.
